title: DEC-240 CI hardening for opum-marketplace (plan item 13)
summary: Apply DEC-240 (opum-doc, accepted 2026-10-25, amended (a2) 2026-10-26) to this repository CI. (1) npm install -g --ignore-scripts for lore and quest (ci.yml lore-check and tracker jobs). (2) persist-credentials: false on every actions/checkout (ci.yml x3, promotion-guards.yml x1); the one post-checkout fetch that runs on the promotion path (assert-main-fast-forward.sh fetching dev) gets the token only through git GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_0/VALUE_0 environment config, never -c and never .git/config (a2). (3) Quest version read only inside the managed quest:agent-instructions markers and exact ^[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+$, failing by name, otherwise never reaching npm. (4) step outputs and github.base_ref reach shell steps through env:, never interpolated inside run:. Floor work (DEC-182 (1)): Sonnet authors, Opus reviews before landing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: both npm install -g lines carry --ignore-scripts; a global install (-g --prefix) of a package with a TRANSITIVE failing postinstall succeeds with the flag and fails without it, proved on setup-node 24 npm
every actions/checkout sets persist-credentials: false and is followed by a live check that no http.*.extraheader is in .git/config, failing by name

the Quest version is read by one script inside the managed markers, ordered by line number; partial, missing-marker, swapped-marker (with a version line after begin), two-version-line and CRLF inputs each fail by name
no ${{ }} appears inside any run: block; values reach shell through env:

the promotion guard takes origin/dev from its fetch-depth: 0 checkout, makes no fetch of its own, receives no token, and fails by name if refs/remotes/origin/dev is missing (leader decision 2026-10-26 under DEC-240 (a2): repository is public, checkout route first)
Opus review before landing; first real dev-to-main promotion measured and reported

implementationNotes: Evidence: PR 231 head 003aa2e9; required contexts green; CI log shows the four new suites 13/12/6/12 passed; install proof ran on npm 10.9.9 in CI and npm 12.2.0 locally. AC 6 stays open on purpose: it needs the Opus review and the first real dev-to-main promotion after landing, which cannot exist before the merge. This task closes in a later change, per the post-merge carve-out.

Rework after Opus REQUEST CHANGES (rv327-mkt231, token d240-mkt-rc): token path dropped by leader decision; M1 marker order by line number; M3 install proof on setup-node 24 npm with -g --prefix and a transitive dependency; M4 live persisted-credential check after every checkout; L5 lint sees continuations, npx, npm exec, any reader of CLAUDE.md. All six criteria rewritten and unchecked until CI on the new head.

Evidence: PR 231 head 3e81e1a2; required contexts green; CI run 40341791007 log: guard suite 24, reader 17, credential check 7, install proof 6 (npm 11.19.0, node 24.21.0), lint 22 all passed; the live check read 7 local git config keys on a real checkout and none matched http.*.extraheader.
